summary: Discusses problems with multicast in Mobile IPv6, including mobile group listeners and mobile senders using Any-Source and Source-Specific Multicast. It surveys existing approaches. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Multicast is like a radio broadcast that many people tune into. This document looks at what goes wrong when a listener or broadcaster moves around while the show goes on.

questions: what are the problems with multicast in mobile ipv6
how does multicast work with mobile nodes
